info.title: Optimize All API
info.description: Paid social sharing campaigns: participants, campaigns, submissions, review, ledger and payouts.

get.summary: Every active achievement with the caller's progress (current metric value) and award time.

put.summary: Updates an achievement. The key cannot change once the achievement has been awarded.

delete.summary: Deletes an achievement that was never awarded; awarded ones can only be deactivated (409 achievement.awarded).
Deletes an unused category; a category referenced by campaigns is deactivated instead.

post.summary: Creates a Draft with reward rules v1 (also requires rewards.edit).
Runs a job now (requires settings.manage in addition to jobs.view).
Public reply (sets AwaitingParticipant and notifies the participant) or internal note.
Creates a verified staff account and emails a set-password (reset) link.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: UTC end (default: now). Range at most 366 days.

get.summary: Same sections for one campaign plus a per-platform breakdown.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: UTC end (default: now). Range at most 366 days.

get.summary: CSV of every overview metric and the per-campaign table (long format).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: UTC end (default: now). Range at most 366 days.

post.summary: Creates a participant account and sends a verification email. Always 202 (no account enumeration).
Returns a short-lived access token and sets the rotating refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie.
Rotates the refresh cookie. Requires the X-Requested-With header (CSRF defence in depth with SameSite=Strict).

get.summary: The signed-in user with roles and effective permissions.
Entries scheduled in [from, to] (default: the next 30 days from today 00:00 UTC; max range 366 days).
Newest first, at most 500; search matches title or slug.
Active campaign categories (anonymous).
Browse Active (and upcoming Scheduled) public campaigns with eligibility for the caller.
Campaigns the caller is eligible for, ranked by interests, platforms, reward and deadline.
Campaign detail by slug. InviteOnly campaigns are unlisted but reachable here; Draft/Archived are 404.

put.summary: Replaces name, hypothesis, element and variants. Only allowed while the experiment is a Draft.

get.summary:
Variant overlays for the caller on every Running experiment of the campaign (sticky assignment). The frontend
overlays these on the campaign detail and sends the variantId with the submission.

Measured results per variant and a two-proportion z-test of each variant's submission rate against control "A".
A difference is only called significant when p < 0.05 and every compared variant has ≥ 100 assignments.

Streams a file. Public campaign/content images are anonymous; submission screenshots only for the owner and
reviewers/campaign managers. Anything the caller may not read is a 404 (existence is not revealed).

post.summary: Uploads a public campaign/content image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 10 MB, 200–10000 px per side).

get.summary: CSV of the ledger with the same filters (max 100,000 rows, newest first).

post.summary: Manual credit/debit. Idempotent by `requestId`: 201 when created, 200 when replayed.

get.summary: Dynamic participant homepage: state, onboarding, banners, announcements and counters.

post.summary: Dismisses a Manual onboarding step (idempotent). Other steps complete automatically.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused link; a link that has been visited or used is deactivated instead (keeps its stats).

post.summary: Submits proof of a post (multipart/form-data with an optional screenshot image).

PostedAt.description: When the post went live (ISO-8601, UTC).

put.summary: Corrects a submission in NeedsCorrection and sends it back to review (multipart/form-data).

post.summary: Appeals a rejection or reversal (once per decision, within the appeal window).

get.summary: Currencies the platform accepts (OptimizeAll.Domain.Common.Money.SupportedCurrencies), alphabetical.
Platform-wide social-profile eligibility minimums (admin settings) that campaigns start from.
Balance buckets in the settlement currency plus the next payout estimate.
The participant's ledger entries, newest first.

put.summary:
Edits a profile. Changing the handle, profile link, creation date or follower count of a Verified or PendingReview
profile resets it to Unverified (the response says so in `verificationReset` and `message`).

delete.summary: Deactivates (never deletes: past submissions reference the profile).

get.summary: The ticket with its public conversation. Internal staff notes are never included.

post.summary: Prepares (or returns the existing) draft batch for a completed period. 201 when created, 200 when it already existed.
Freezes a draft batch for payment (four-eyes). Items are then dispatched to the payment provider.
Re-dispatches items awaiting payment; existing payment attempts are reused (idempotent).

get.summary:
Sensitive: CSV of the items awaiting payment with the DECRYPTED payout destination, for paying manually.
Requires `?confirm=true`; every export is audited and the first one sets `InstructionsExportedAt`
(after which the batch can no longer be cancelled).
Items whose participant has an active payout hold or an inactive account are NOT payable: they appear after the
payable rows as companion rows whose Status is `EXCLUDED`, whose destination is withheld and replaced by the
reason ("EXCLUDED — do not pay: …").

put.summary: Inserts a new schedule version effective from `effectiveFrom`.

get.summary: Published FAQ grouped by category. Anonymous.
Active announcements whose audience matches the signed-in user.

Invitation landing payload. 404 when the link is inactive, expired or used up. Counts the visit, except for a
staff preview (preview = true from a caller holding marketing.manage), which also makes no
experiment assignment. `preview` from anyone else is ignored.
Public landing page of an Active or Scheduled public campaign.

302 to the campaign destination with the link's UTM parameters. The destination always comes from stored
configuration (never from the request), so the endpoint cannot be used as an open redirect.

post.summary:
Server-to-server conversion postback signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body
(header X-OA-Signature: sha256=<hex>). Idempotent per (link, externalReference).

get.summary: The caller's referral code, link, program terms, stats and referred participants (masked).

parameters.name: Flagged
parameters.description: true = only referrals with fraud signals; false = only without.

post.summary: Rejects a referral; declines a pending reward or reverses an approved (unpaid) one. Audited.

get.summary: Messages sent per kind in [from, to] (default last 30 days).
Sent retention messages, newest first. Search matches the participant's name or email.

parameters.name: Flagged
parameters.description: true = only submissions with unresolved flags; false = only unflagged.

parameters.name: ClaimedByMe
parameters.description: true = only submissions I currently hold an active claim on.

get.summary: Everything needed to review one submission side by side with the campaign requirements.

parameters.name: Due
parameters.description: true (default) = only checks whose due time has passed.

get.summary: All rule set versions (newest first) with their rules and how many submissions reference each.

post.summary: Saves a new version (sensitive: rewards.edit + confirm + reason). Existing submissions keep their version.
Prices a hypothetical post with a saved version or unsaved draft rules.
Decides a PendingReview profile (409 `social.not_pending` otherwise). Staff can't review their own profiles.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused template; a template referenced by campaign assets or calendar entries is archived instead.

post.summary: Returns (creating once) the caller's tracking link for a campaign. 409 tracking.not_enabled without a destination.

destination.description: Raw IBAN / account number / PayPal email / wallet number. Encrypted at rest and never returned.

value.description: The new value as JSON (number, boolean or object depending on the key).

Analytics.MetricDto.description: One metric. Percent values are 0–100 (2 decimals); money values carry OptimizeAll.Api.Modules.Analytics.MetricDto.Currency. Null = undefined (no data).

deviceId.description: Opaque client device identifier (random per browser); only its hash is stored, for referral fraud checks.

publicLandingPath.description: App-relative public landing page (`/c/{slug}`); only reachable while the campaign is Public and Scheduled/Active.

Campaigns.CampaignOptionDto.description: An entry of GET /campaigns/options (staff campaign pickers).

slug.description: Lower-case URL slug; generated from the title when omitted.
Lower-case URL slug; generated from the title when omitted.

confirm.description: Required (true) with a reason when the budget changes.

ids.description: Ids in the desired display order. Listed items get SortOrder 10, 20, 30…; unlisted items keep theirs.

requestId.description: Client-generated id of this request; retries/double-clicks with the same id return the same adjustment.

amount.description: Signed amount: positive credits, negative debits. Must not be zero.

Ledger.CurrencyBreakdownDto.description: Original-currency totals of ledger entries per status bucket.

Ledger.PendingCurrencyDto.description: Estimated rewards of open submissions in their original currency; `Converted` is false when no FX rate exists.

concurrencyStamp.description: For updates: the stamp the client last saw (stale writes get 409 concurrency.conflict).

campaignId.description: Null = platform invitation; otherwise the campaign whose landing page the link opens.

Payouts.PayoutPeriodDto.description: A payout period: earnings with AvailableAt in (periodStart, cutoffAt] are paid on/after paymentDate.

periodKey.description: Cutoff local date (yyyy-MM-dd) of the period; default: the last completed period.

overrideReason.description:
Required to record a payment for a participant with an active payout hold (e.g. the transfer already left the
account before the hold was placed). Audited as `payout.payment_hold_overridden`.

effectiveFrom.description: When the new version takes effect (UTC, not in the past).

reason.description: Required (5+ characters after trimming) unless approving.

note.description: Required (5+ characters after trimming) when the result is Removed.
At least 5 characters after trimming (400 review.reason_too_short).

reason.description: At least 5 characters after trimming (400 review.reason_too_short).

confirm.description: Must be true: changing rates is a sensitive action.

ruleSetVersion.description: Saved version to price with; default = the current version.

campaignBudgetRemaining.description: Budget remaining to assume; default = the campaign's actual remaining budget.

Rewards.RewardRuleSetInput.description: A complete rule set (rates, bonuses and caps). Saving it always creates a new immutable version.

verifiedAccountCreatedAt.description: Corrects the participant-declared creation date after checking the profile.

Support.ParticipantMessageDto.description: A message as the participant sees it. Staff authors are shown as the support team.
